verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a passing note that older CLI commands still work but emit a deprecation warning (crewai-docs-26), which shows some deprecation practice exists but is not a documented, general deprecation policy for versioned APIs. There is no SemVer commitment, API stability guarantee, or dedicated versioning/deprecation policy page, and a probe for an OpenAPI/API spec returned 404s (crewai-probe-3). missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme (e.g., SemVer), a published deprecation policy document, and evidence of REST/SDK API version guarantees beyond CLI warnings.
